name: Celesta Glow Gentle Cleanser
tagline: Cleanse Deep. Age Slow. Glow Daily
description: A mild, pH-balanced daily cleanser designed to remove dirt, excess oil, and impurities without disrupting the skin barrier. It helps refine skin texture, improve clarity, and support a smoother, youthful-looking complexion
ingredients_full: Aqua, Stearic Acid, Sodium Laureth Sulfate, Coco Fatty, Potassium Hydroxide, Sorbitol, Lauric Acid, Aloe Vera Leaf Extract, Cocamide MEA, Myristic Acid, Sodium Lactate, Sodium Gluconate, Palmitic Acid, Propylene Glycol, Salicylic Acid, Pea Protein (Pisum Sativum) Enzymatically Hydrolyzed, Phenoxyethanol, Ethylhexylglycerin, Stevioside, Tea Tree Oil, Fragrance, Sodium Gluconate*, Clove Oil
how_to_use: Apply to clean, dry skin on the face and neck. Use in the evening. Follow with sunscreen during the day.
